title: Secure Financial Data Bridge
business: A regional bank migrating sensitive transaction processing to Google Cloud while maintaining strict compliance requirements for private, non-internet-exposed traffic.
problem: The bank faces high latency and security risks when routing sensitive financial data over public internet tunnels, which fails to meet their internal audit requirements for dedicated private connectivity.
solution: Cloud Interconnect provides dedicated or partner private connectivity to Google Cloud VPC networks, allowing the bank to bypass the public internet and establish a direct, private physical connection between their on-premises data center and their VPC.
steps: Provision a physical connection through a supported service provider or direct cross-connect at a Google colocation facility.
Configure a Cloud Router in the target VPC to manage BGP sessions for dynamic route exchange.
Establish VLAN attachments to map specific on-premises traffic to the VPC subnets.
Verify the BGP session state to ensure routes are being advertised and learned correctly.
outcome: The bank achieves a consistent, private, and secure network path for financial transactions, ensuring compliance with internal security mandates.
limitation: Cloud Interconnect requires physical infrastructure coordination and lead time for provisioning; verify status by checking the BGP session state and route advertisements in the Cloud Router console.

questions.question: In Secure Financial Data Bridge, why is Cloud Interconnect chosen over public internet tunnels?
options: It provides dedicated or partner private connectivity to Google Cloud VPC networks.
It automatically encrypts all data at the application layer.
It is the only way to access Google Cloud APIs.
It eliminates the need for a VPC network.
questions.explanation: The scenario highlights the need for private, non-internet-exposed traffic, which is addressed by the dedicated or partner private connectivity provided by Cloud Interconnect.

By checking the BGP session state and route advertisements in the Cloud Router console.
By pinging the Google public DNS.
